mapper.select: select pldinfo.PBC_ACCOUNT_ID pbcAccountId,/*资产池代码*/ pldinfo.PROD_ID prodId,/*内部产品代码*/ pldinfo.ASSET_CODE assetCode,/*资产代码*/ cai.ASSET_NAME assetName,/*资产名称*/ pldinfo.LOANS_TYPE loansType,/*贷款种类*/ pldinfo.LOAN_TRANSFEROR_ID loanTransferorId,/*贷款转让方机构代码*/ pldinfo.LOAN_TRANSFEROR_NAME loanTransferorName,/*贷款转让方机构名称*/ pldinfo.LOAN_CONTRACT_ORG_ID loanContractOrgId,/*贷款合同原始发放机构代码*/ pldinfo.LOAN_CONTRACT_ORG_NAME loanContractOrgName,/*贷款合同原始发放机构名称*/ pldinfo.LOAN_CONTRACT_ORG_COUNTY loanContractOrgCounty,/*贷款合同原始发放机构所在地(县)*/ pldinfo.BORROWER_TYPE industryInfo,/*行业信息*/ pldinfo.ENTERPRISE_INVESTOR_TYPE_FIRST enterpriseInvestorTypeFirst,/*企业出资人经济成分（一级）*/ pldinfo.ENTERPRISE_INVESTOR_TYPE_SEC enterpriseInvestorTypeSec,/*企业出资人经济成分（二级）*/ pldinfo.ENTERPRISE_INVESTOR_TYPE_THIRD enterpriseInvestorTypeThird,/*企业出资人经济成分（三级）*/ pldinfo.ENTERPRISE_SCALE enterpriseScale,/*企业规模*/ pldinfo.LOAN_BASIS_ID loanBasisId,/*贷款借据编码*/ pldinfo.LOAN_EXTENSION_DUE_DATE loanExtensionDueDate,/*贷款展期到期日期*/ pldinfo.RATE_FIXED rateFixed,/*利率是否固定*/ pldinfo.RATE_LEVEL rateLevel,/*利率水平(%)*/ pldinfo.LOAN_GUARANTEE_MODE loanGuaranteeMode,/*贷款担保方式*/ pldinfo.LOAN_QUALITY loanQuality,/*贷款质量*/ pldinfo.LOAN_STATE loanState,/*贷款状态*/ pldinfo.LOAN_TRANSFEROR_RATE loanTransferorRate,/*贷款转让折扣率(%)*/ pldinfo.ORIG_CCY pldinfo.ASSET_CODE=cai.ASSET_CODE and cai.STATUS != 'D' where pldinfo.REPORTUUID=#{reportuuid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select pctds.PBC_ACCOUNT_ID pbcAccountId,/*资产池代码*/ pctds.PROD_ID prodId,/*内部产品代码*/ pctds.ASSET_CODE assetCode,/*资产代码*/ cai.ASSET_NAME assetName,/*资产名称*/ pctds.STOCK_TYPE stockType,/*股权种类*/ pctds.CAPITAL_TRUST_ORG_CODE capitalTrustOrgCode,/*产品发起机构编码*/ pctds.POBCASSETID pobcassetid,/*人行资金信托代码*/ pctds.CCY ccy,/*币种代码*/ pctds.CAPITAL_TRUST_AMOUNT capitalTrustAmount,/*资金信托产品余额*/ pctds.CAPITAL_TRUST_AMOUNT_CNY capitalTrustAmountCny/*资金信托产品余额折人民币*/ from PBC_CAPITAL_TRUST_DETAIL_SUB pctds left join chb_asset_info cai on pctds.ASSET_CODE=cai.ASSET_CODE and cai.STATUS != 'D' where pctds.REPORTUUID=#{reportuuid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
